title: Karen Martínez
intro:
Report an officeholder change
Karen Martínez is a member of the San Jose-Evergreen Community College District Board in California, representing Trustee Area 2. Martínez assumed office in 2018. Martínez's current term ends on December 11, 2026.
Martínez is running for re-election to the San Jose-Evergreen Community College District Board to represent Trustee Area 2 in California. Martínez is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Martínez also ran for election to the San Jose City Council to represent District 5 in California. Martínez lost in the primary on June 2, 2026.
